source.title: Belfast News-Letter, 5 May 1955, p. 6; Belfast News-Letter, 6 May 1955, p. 10 ("Municipal elections in Ulster: eighty-four candidates for 52 seats in City Council")
source.publisher: Belfast News-Letter (via the Irish Newspaper Archives)
source.check: names as printed in the News-Letter's nomination list; the ward was not among the 11 contested after withdrawals (Belfast News-Letter, 6 May 1955, p. 10)

note: Triennial election of Belfast Corporation, polled Wednesday 18 May 1955: 84 candidates for 52 seats (45 councillors and the aldermen of seven wards) in 11 of the 15 wards after withdrawals (Belfast News-Letter, 6 May 1955, p. 10). Aldermanic seats were filled in seven wards. Returned unopposed.
